text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh! Seeeiiyaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Focus more on rotating your hips!
Cut through the wind, like this! Just like this!

One day, Seeking the Pearl and the others
were practicing swinging with brooms.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing special training. To conquer that thing
King is terrible at, smartly and speedily!

"That" turned out to be a spiderweb on the window.
King Halo, who happened to be on cleaning duty,
approached while trying to keep it out of her line of sight.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I ran away earlier, but now that I've done special training...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Here I go... Haah...!!
King Halo bravely confronts the spiderweb. However—
(Rustle rustle rustle rustle!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Noooooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What was that sound just now?!
D-D-Don't come near me~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Shaking like that... you don't have to push yourself, you know?
Overcoming it all at once is very hard!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just finding the courage to face it is huge progress!
Leave the rest to me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
!! Please wait, Pearl-senpai!
Cleaning duty is my responsibility!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I am a first-class Umamusume! Running away here is the one thing I won't do... I'll clean this up myself, no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
King...! ...Yes, I understand.
In that case, I will cooperate with you to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Still, before taking another shot at it,
let's take a break first and regain our strength.

And while King Halo took a break,
Seeking the Pearl dashed all around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're really good at the synthesizer, aren't you?
That powerful sound I sometimes hear coming from the plaza...
I need your help!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I need your soul-stirring singing voice!
You over there, too! Let your angelic voice ring out—one that no one can ever forget once heard!

Seeking the Pearl went around calling out to students
all over campus, gathering allies one after another.

By the time I returned to King Halo,
I had a huge crowd of students trailing behind me...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Umm, what's going on here?
Everyone is even holding instruments... A marching band?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I put together a cheer squad just for you.
Dedicated to our proud King.
One, two, one-two-three-four—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whatcha gonna do, oh, yeah yeah♪

A bouncing synth line accompanied by high-energy backing vocals!
It feels just like being in a dance hall!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
King of Kings! Oh, yeah yeah!
Ever aiming higher, truly fit to be King♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone knows, you've got what it takes♪
Echoing through the world—Cool Pride!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fear and running away don't suit me at all~♪
Rouse your spirit and step onto the road!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
King of Kings! Oh, yeah yeah!
First class, you are the Kiiing!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I was completely captivated by your voice.
A cheer befitting someone truly first-rate...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The rest is up to you.
Whether you retreat and show your back, or step forward and fight.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. After everything's been set up this nicely, backing down now would disgrace the King name!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —It's just a spider web! Yaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We did it...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai...!
I did it! I defeated the spiderweb!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!!
My heart was deeply moved by your indomitable courage!
You're the best, King! Absolutely the best!
choice_data_list: Looks like I might even overcome my fear of bugs at this rate.
That was some powerful broom work!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're right, let's move on to the next training!
I'll move around like a bug, so try to swat me away!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *Rustle rustle rustle! Rustle rustle rustle rustle!*

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
S-Stooooop!!
Pearl-senpai, isn't that getting a little too real?!

To help King Halo overcome her weakness,
Seeking the Pearl's new special training began!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! The special training paid off completely! If we keep this up, we'll be able to catch a real spider even if it jumps right out at us!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait, is that the real deal?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you'll be able to do it eventually.
You are a proud King, after all!

Thanks in part to Seeking the Pearl's cheering,
King Halo was able to finish cleaning every last spot!
